description: This file defines the LanguageMapper class for managing language code mappings and discovery for CKEditor 5 translations within a Drupal module. It handles caching, file system scanning for translation files, and language code mapping between Drupal and CKEditor.

classes.name: LanguageMapper
classes.description: Manages language mappings and discovery for CKEditor 5 translations, including caching and language code translation logic.

methods.name: getMappings
methods.description: Returns a list of supported CKEditor 5 language codes, utilizing cache and file system scanning.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns the CKEditor 5 language code corresponding to a given Drupal language code.
